# Torben Knudsen

Torben Knudsen is a clinical professor and senior physician at Region Syddanmark, serving as a steering committee member for [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease. Knudsen holds the qualifications of *Klinisk professor, ledende overlæge dr.med., ph.d.* and was documented as part of DANIBD's steering group in both the 2023 and 2024 reporting periods [^src1][^src2].

DANIBD's steering committee represents clinical expertise from across Denmark's five regions, combined with epidemiological and data management support from RKKP. The steering group's composition reflects the breadth of the database's scope: during the period October 1, 2022 to September 30, 2023, DANIBD tracked treatment for 33,381 patients with inflammatory bowel disease across Danish regions, with biological therapies (BMSL) administered to 10,523 patients [^src3]. Knudsen's inclusion in this governance structure reflects his role in clinical leadership within the Southern Denmark region's IBD care system.
